street_once_01.prompt: One continuous photoreal locked tripod wide shot of a lantern market in Tang dynasty Chang'an. People in the first picture take one short natural walk to their positions in the ending picture. The two companions in pink and pale green by the left stall walk together toward the center of their stall, exchange a small gesture, lower their hands and stand watching the distant lights. The man at the right shop turns and settles beside his friend. The cloth awning ripples gently then settles. Body weight settles on planted feet. The last second holds quiet resting poses. Warm amber exposure, fixed lens, continuous street geometry, clean central lane. Quiet natural night ambience, no music, dialogue, titles or magic.
